surface_strategies.cards: Glassmorphism using expo-blur <BlurView intensity={30} tint='dark' />. Must include 1px inner border using border_subtle color to define edges. Use subtle expo-linear-gradient behind key metrics.
surface_strategies.buttons: Primary CTA uses Accent Primary (#FF3B30) background with high-contrast text. Must include drop shadow matching the background color to create a neon glow: shadowColor: '#FF3B30', shadowRadius: 16, shadowOpacity: 0.6.
surface_strategies.bottom_nav: Floating bento-style tab bar. Absolute positioning at bottom. BlurView background. Active icon receives neon glow and color change (e.g., #00FFFF).
surface_strategies.dashboard_widgets: Bento box grid layout. Mix of 1x1, 1x2, and 2x2 widgets. Generous gap (16px). Use negative space effectively.

animations_and_motion.general: Utilize react-native-reanimated for fluid, physics-based motion.
animations_and_motion.page_transitions: Fade in + translateY (20px to 0px) using spring physics.
animations_and_motion.interactions: Scale components down to 0.95 on onPressIn. Release back to 1 on onPressOut.
animations_and_motion.background_effects: Floating AI particles on Landing Screen. Pulsing opacity on AI Chat button.

screens.landing: Full-screen background image overlaid with linear-gradient fading to black at bottom. Floating glowing AI demo element. Glassmorphic login sheet.
screens.onboarding: Step-by-step horizontal pager. Progress bar at top with a glowing neon segment indicating completion. Large typography for questions.
screens.dashboard: Greeting + Core stats. Hero element: Large circular Calorie Ring with a glowing sweep effect. 4 Quick Action cards in a 2x2 grid.
screens.meal_plan: Timeline/vertical list of generated meals. AI reasoning displayed in secondary text. Accent borders on the left side of cards based on meal type.
screens.scan_food: Camera view taking top 65%. Bottom sheet with extreme blur containing results. Good/Limit/Avoid status displayed as high-contrast neon pill badges.
screens.ai_chat: Chat UI. AI bubbles: dark surface with 1px Cyan border and subtle cyan glow. User bubbles: dark surface without glow. Typing indicator: glowing bouncing dots.
screens.recipe_feed: Full-width or large bento cards. High quality imagery taking most of the card, dark gradient overlay at the bottom for text readability.
screens.progress: Vertical timeline. Connecting lines use border_subtle. Data points use glowing dots.
screens.profile: Minimalist list view. High contrast. Simple.

landing_background.description: Abstract neon lights for the landing page background

instructions_to_main_agent: Design for React Native + Expo. Do not use HTML/CSS or web-specific libraries like Framer Motion or Shadcn.
Use StyleSheet, Reanimated, and Expo Blur/Linear-Gradient.
Strictly follow the Dark Mode + Neon Glow archetype. Pure black base (#000000) with Flame Orange (#FF3B30) and Cyan (#00FFFF) accents.
Use deep matte blacks. Avoid generic grays.
All containers must have generous padding (24px default).
Use `Unbounded` for Headings and `Outfit` for body text. Headings must be bold and tightly tracked.
Implement glassmorphism heavily for cards, bottom navigation, and modals. Use a 1px `rgba(255,255,255,0.08)` border to give it crisp edges.
Ensure the bottom navigation is floating above the content, with a glass effect and a glowing active icon.
All interactive elements must include `testID` attribute (React Native equivalent of data-testid).
Do NOT use web-based DOM elements like <div> or <span>. Use <View>, <Text>, <Image>, <TouchableOpacity>, <ScrollView>, etc.
